technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with three white soldiers and rising RSI/OBV, but price remains below intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings announcement in 1 day with elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (581+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (350.56), flat yield curve recession signal, rising dollar headwind, and imminent earnings binary event create severely adverse conditions for OMC trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + rising RSI/OBV/Supertrend show genuine short-term momentum reversal with price near support (56.44), offering contrarian entry in extreme fear regime.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 1 day combined with VIX crisis (350.56), price below all intermediate moving averages, and zero fundamental/institutional support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Three white soldiers and rising RSI/OBV show short-term momentum, but earnings binary event in 1 day creates unacceptable risk that overrides technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement tomorrow will likely gap price violently in either direction, invalidating swing trade thesis and triggering stop-loss or forced exit.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; bear case dominates
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding OMC with 12 other Communication Services positions (4% sector concentration); earnings proximity and VIX crisis regime make additional exposure unjustifiable.
